; The pinned ASSET-ROW fixture (plans/23-asset-growth.md, Phase 2).
;
; It is read by `GET /api/projections/asset-growth-scenario.journal`, whose
; response is committed as `fixtures/native/v1/projections-asset.json` — so the
; asset half of the scenario wire is pinned byte for byte beside every other
; native endpoint.
;
; DELIBERATELY NOT NAMED `projection-*.journal`. The picker groups those first
; under their own heading, and `fixtures/sample.journal` is what the Projections
; e2e spec reads the picker against — a new heading there would be a change to
; that spec for the sake of a filename. "Really any journal file with
; budget-like entries could be used", and this is one. A direct read still picks
; up the `; projection:` name above, because that route re-reads the header
; rather than trusting the listing.
;
; An ASSET ROW is a posting whose amount is the per-period CONTRIBUTION — `$0`
; when the balance only compounds — carrying a `growth:` tag, on an account the
; journal types as an asset. Verified against hledger 1.52: `print --forecast`
; round-trips the `$0` posting with its tags, `balance --budget` reports a goal
; for the contribution and NONE for a `$0` row (a growth rate is not a goal),
; and `tag:growth` matches all three.

~ monthly  brokerage and savings plan
    (assets:broker:taxable:vti)     $0.00  ; growth: 7%/yr
    (assets:bank:savings)         $250.00  ; growth: 4%/yr, line: savings
    (assets:property:home)          $0.00  ; growth: 3%/yr, opening: 640000.00
    (expenses:housing:rent)      $1875.00  ; growth: 2%/yr

; THE COMPATIBILITY RULE, in the fixture rather than only in a test: a posting
; with NO `growth:` tag is a flow line whatever its account. Both of these are
; flows, and a reader that guessed "an `assets:` account means an asset row"
; would model this sweep as two compounding balances.

The pinned ASSET-ROW fixture (plans/23-asset-growth.md, Phase 2).

It is read by `GET /api/projections/asset-growth-scenario.journal`, whose
response is committed as `fixtures/native/v1/projections-asset.json` — so the
asset half of the scenario wire is pinned byte for byte beside every other
native endpoint.

DELIBERATELY NOT NAMED `projection-*.journal`. The picker groups those first
under their own heading, and `fixtures/sample.journal` is what the Projections
e2e spec reads the picker against — a new heading there would be a change to
that spec for the sake of a filename. "Really any journal file with
budget-like entries could be used", and this is one. A direct read still picks
up the `; projection:` name above, because that route re-reads the header
rather than trusting the listing.

An ASSET ROW is a posting whose amount is the per-period CONTRIBUTION — `$0`
when the balance only compounds — carrying a `growth:` tag, on an account the
journal types as an asset. Verified against hledger 1.52: `print --forecast`
round-trips the `$0` posting with its tags, `balance --budget` reports a goal
for the contribution and NONE for a `$0` row (a growth rate is not a goal),
and `tag:growth` matches all three.
